ingredients: Base: 1 cup (2.4 dl) white granulated sugar
Topping: 4 ounces (110 g) softened cream cheese
Topping: ¼ cup (0.6 dl) maraschino cherry syrup
Topping: ¼ cup (0.6 dl) icing sugar
Topping: ½ cup (1.2 dl) semi-sweet chocolate chips
Topping: ½ cup (1.2 dl) maraschino cherries
steps: Melt margarine in a saucepan over medium-low heat, then mix in the cocoa.
Add the base sugar, salt, and eggs. Mix well and then fold in the flour.
Spread in a greased 9 x 9-inch (22 x 22 cm) cake pan and set aside.
Beat the cream cheese, cherry syrup and icing sugar together in a bowl until creamy.
Add the topping egg to the mixture and blend well.
Mix in the chocolate chips and cherries.
Pour the second mixture over top the base.
Bake at 350 °F/175 °C for 30–40 minutes, until a toothpick poked through the centre comes out moist (but not wet with batter).
Let cool and cut into 36 squares.
